origin: The word list supplied with the research materials for Milshtein's published A(17,4,5) construction. The original file header states A(17,4,5) >= 444.

paper.title: A new binary (17,4,5) constant weight code
paper.author: Moshe Milshtein

method: The paper describes computer search for a maximum independent set using a stochastic local-search algorithm based on Generic Scuba Search.
ai_provenance: The paper does not report use of generative AI and does not give a separate AI-provenance statement. Do not infer more than this.
reproduction: The 444 binary strings were parsed and checked for length 17, weight 5, uniqueness, and pairwise Hamming distance at least 4.
